validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and in construction. This is Package 15 of Aramco's Master Gas System Phase 3 (MGS-3). MEED ('Aramco selects contractors for Master Gas System expansion') describes Package 15 verbatim as 'Laying 20-inch, 16-inch, 12-inch and 4-inch lateral pipelines from Yanbu to Rabigh, covering 192km', awarded to Kalpataru Power Transmission (India). Independently corroborated by Tube & Pipe India (citing contractor KPIL/Kalpataru's own LoI disclosure), which states Package 15 = 192 km lateral pipelines, 20/16/12/4 in, Yanbu to Rabigh. These are independent origins (UK trade press vs. Indian trade press sourced from the awarded contractor), not GEM-derived. CLASSIFICATION: correct as gas transmission. MGS-3 is explicitly a natural-gas transport/transmission expansion (the 15 pipeline packages 'relate to laying gas transport pipelines'); blackridge/search corroborate it carries non-associated/unconventional gas + condensate feed into the Master Gas System. Caveat: the small mixed diameters (20/16/12/4 in) mark this as a LATERAL bundle, not a single 56-in trunk like most other MGS-3 rows (P6717-P6731); it is still correctly typed 'transmission' as part of the MGS network, just narrow-bore laterals. DUPLICATE: none. Roster scan shows no other Yanbu-Rabigh row; the nearest look-alike is P6733 (470 km, 12,16,10,4 in) which is the Riyadh-cluster Package 13 (different route/length), so distinct. SPEC: length 192 km (MEED + Tube&Pipe), diameter 20,16,12,4 in (MEED + Tube&Pipe, verbatim 'lateral' diameters), status construction (MGS-3 construction commenced Q2 2024), owner Aramco 100% (MEED + Aramco), start year 2028 (MGS-3 scheduled completion Q4 2028 per multiple sources). The Aramco.com $25bn award page that GEM cites for the start year was unreachable today (repeated ReadTimeout, server-side), so 2028 was corroborated instead via the broadly-reported MGS-3 Q4 2028 completion target rather than that single page. The MEED page lacks the literal diameter string '20,16,12,4' as one token (it spells the diameters out individually, which all verify) and lacks '2028', so the verifier 'data value not found' flag on Diameter is a tokenization artifact, not a data conflict.

fills.researcher_notes: Endpoints Yanbu (start) -> Rabigh (end) are stated explicitly by both MEED ('lateral pipelines from Yanbu to Rabigh') and Tube & Pipe India (Package 15, Yanbu to Rabigh). Both verify (Yanbu, Rabigh, 192 all present). Yanbu lies in Al Madinah province and Rabigh in Makkah province (existing GEM province values left unchanged); the endpoint cities are the source-supported part.
